snippet.title: Civilization AGA (Amiga) - Easy mode playthrough
snippet.description:
Trying to conquer the world as the Romans on the EARTH map (with max number of opponents).
Usually I don't play on Warlord (level 2 out of 5) but it's for the EAB/Lemon competition where that is the difficulty to be used.

Sound gets out of synch after a while (WinUAE video recording seems to have problems with long phases of silence which this game has plenty of).
